koreaUnlockChecklist.label: data.go.kr local equity key
koreaUnlockChecklist.detail: Set DATA_GO_KR_SERVICE_KEY to unlock Samsung, SK Hynix, Hanwha Aerospace, LIG Nex1, KAI, Hyundai Rotem, and Hanwha Ocean daily closes.

koreaUnlockChecklist.label: KOSPI/KOSDAQ index export
koreaUnlockChecklist.detail: Create data/private/korea-index-prices.json with npm run import:korea:index or a validated KRX Data Marketplace export.

koreaUnlockChecklist.label: BOK ECOS key
koreaUnlockChecklist.detail: Set BOK_ECOS_API_KEY for BOK rates/current-account/trade-balance ingestion.

koreaUnlockChecklist.label: BOK series mappings
koreaUnlockChecklist.detail: Configure BOK_BASE_RATE_*, BOK_CURRENT_ACCOUNT_*, and BOK_TRADE_BALANCE_* STAT_CODE/ITEM_CODE env vars.

koreaUnlockChecklist.label: Foreign equity flow export
koreaUnlockChecklist.detail: Create data/private/korea-macro-flows.json with npm run import:korea:macro or a validated KRX/BOK export.

failures: DATA_GO_KR_SERVICE_KEY is not configured; Korean local equities remain evidence-only until official KRX-backed prices are available.
KOSPI index prices require data/private/korea-index-prices.json exported from KRX Data Marketplace.
KOSDAQ index prices require data/private/korea-index-prices.json exported from KRX Data Marketplace.
BOK_ECOS_API_KEY is not configured; BOK macro/rates inputs require ECOS series mappings or data/private/korea-macro-flows.json.
Foreign equity flow requires KRX investor-flow data in data/private/korea-macro-flows.json or a configured KRX API adapter.

notes: All generated records include required provenance fields and core datasets are populated.
